call_input.prompt:
Create exactly ONE fully finished flat launch poster image for a fictional collapsible silicone cup, portrait aspect ratio exactly 4:5. Output at the maximum resolution currently supported by the tool and model while preserving that requested aspect ratio. The image itself is the complete poster, with all typography and photographic product imagery integrated; no mockup, frame, paper-on-wall scene, panel grid, contact sheet, or multiple variants.

The content determines the composition: two physically plausible states of the SAME handleless cup appear side by side on one continuous studio surface. The tall expanded cup is on the left, and the low compressed version is on the right, on the same ground line and photographed with the same perspective. They have matching rim diameters, bases, dark forest-green silicone bodies and frosted translucent-white lids. They are TWO states of one model, not different products. The tall cup is a tapered vessel with concentric flexible accordion sections visible in its side wall. The low cup has those same concentric sections cleanly nested into a shallow stack, with the same translucent-white lid seated on its top and the same silicone base resting on the floor. The actual photo must clearly communicate how the tall wall could nest into the shorter state. No handles, hands, straws, accessories, props, or letters embossed/printed anywhere on either product.

Use a real-studio-product-photo appearance, not an illustration or glossy plastic CGI render. Slightly elevated frontal three-quarter view; both top ellipses and the lid thickness are readable. The lids are subtly milky translucent white with visible diffused light through the edge, rather than opaque glossy white. The body is dark green matte silicone, gently textured with soft rounded fold grooves, modest broad highlights and realistic thickness. One soft key light from upper left, consistent restrained shadows extending right and local contact shadows at both bases. Sharp but natural boundaries, no melted seams, no floating cup, no phantom rings. A cool very pale gray studio sweep provides a calm continuous background and ground, without a horizon stripe or decorative texture. No actual brands or logos.

Compose the cup pair as the main visual structure, with the expanded cup noticeably taller than the folded cup, same model diameter. Leave the empty space above the low right cup for the product name and its folding statement. This empty height is part of the message: the name and words take the space released by the collapsed object. The left cup should be large enough to examine its lid, taper, and fold joints; both states remain complete within the frame, with separated silhouettes and no edge contact. Keep the name medium-large, not a giant fixed top headline. Put the modest fictional wordmark copy at the upper left, aligned with the tall cup. Put the product name in the right-side height above the short cup, with a considered two-line display break between its words. Below the name put the Korean slogan as two natural phrase lines, preserving the original words and punctuation. Align the specification near the expanded cup's lower boundary to name the visible two-state relation. Below the photo's ground contact, allow clear negative space and create a readable release / advance-order information relation: the release date in the left column, the preorder period and shop address in the right column, with the shop address adjacent to the preorder period. Their spatial alignment extends the tall-left/short-right relation without becoming an unrelated copy list or a boxed footer. No rules, arrows, icons, state labels, capsules, badges, extra group headings, decorative letters, or invented information. Use crisp unornamented dark green typography of compatible Latin and Korean stroke density, optical spacing and generous readable line leading. All required copy must be easy to read at an image display width of 720 px; allocate enough space especially to the preorder line and URL. Typography stays on clean pale background and never touches lids, highlights or shadows. Make the two product forms the first clear recognition, followed immediately by the name and folding statement, then specification and purchase timing.

These are the ONLY seven visible copy values, each printed exactly once. Preserve exact spelling, case, spaces, punctuation, digits, dot, and the en dash. Natural line breaks inside a value are permitted; do not rewrite or translate it:
FOLN
Fold Cup
가볍게 접고, 다시 펼치다
350 mL · 접이식 실리콘 컵
2026.12.01 RELEASE
온라인 사전 주문 11.10–11.30
foln.example/store

No text beyond those seven copy values. In particular no text on cup surfaces, no real logos, no extra slogan, no prices, performance claims, certification claims, watermark, or microprint. The provided capacity is communicated only through the specified copy; do not invent measured dimensions. Deliver one coherent finished 4:5 flat poster, not a design specification.

inspection_actual_views.scope: Full native original, all seven copy values, Korean glyphs and punctuation, both cup structures, lid material, boundaries, surface contact and lighting; no crop
Full width-720 QA view, all seven copy values and order/readability path
Full long-edge-320 QA view, first recognition, pair height relationship and title hierarchy

copy_transcription.comparison: Visually read at native and 720; upper-left poster copy only
Words and case preserved; permitted natural line break
Visually read at native and 720; words and comma preserved, permitted phrase line break
Visually read at native and 720; mL case and visible 350 mL gap preserved
Visually read at native and 720; date and uppercase RELEASE preserved
Words and numbers clearly read at native and 720; visible range dash appears en-dash-length. Raster cannot authenticate Unicode or distinguish literal spaces from glyph bearings around the dash
Visually read at native and 720; complete lowercase URL preserved

strengths: One complete flat poster, with two photographed-looking product states on one continuous surface; no panels or mockup
Handleless dark-green matte bodies, pale translucent-white seated lids, consistent upper-left soft light and visible local contact shadows
The name and folding statement use the space above the shorter right-hand state; specification is near the tall body and the two timing groups are readable
All seven supplied copy values are legible in the native and width-720 views; no additional product labeling, fake microtext, icon or watermark observed
uncertainties: Dash Unicode and literal encoded spacing cannot be certified from raster; the line is visually transcribed with an en dash
The two states suggest accordion nesting but their exact physical fold mapping is not verified
Maximum supported native resolution was requested through the prompt only; tool schema supplies no size parameter and actual maximum achievement is unconfirmed
Capacity is stated by supplied copy only; no physical 350 mL measurement, function test, authorship attribution or print certification is claimed
Only this assigned poster was inspected; pair diversity and total quantity are central scope

remaining_defects.finding: The large two-line name attracts attention alongside the tall cup; the pair itself is not unambiguously the sole first fixation
remaining_defects.impact: The intended product-pair-first hierarchy is partly shared with the title
